name: By kind
summary: Mechanical baseline: sort every file by what it is. Use when nothing else has signal, or as the comparison point when choosing a layout (`slopkeeper propose`).
when_to_use: The corpus is a shapeless dump with no project or topic structure at all.
You want the cheapest defensible layout before the owner weighs in.
You are comparing layouts and need the mechanical baseline's costs.
partitioning_rubric: docs/ takes markdown, text, PDFs, HTML and office documents.
data/ takes structured formats: JSON, YAML, TOML, CSV, logs, SQL.
scripts/ takes code; media/ takes images, audio, video and archives.
Files with no recognizable kind go to misc/ and are listed as unresolved.
This layout flattens structure — subdirectories do not survive it. Prefer projects or hybrid whenever any signal exists; by-kind is the floor, not the goal.

folder_template.agents_md_skeleton:
# <Kind>

Everything of this file kind, sorted mechanically. Reclassify by hand where the kind is wrong — the sort knows extensions, not meaning.

example.docs: every markdown note, PDF and docx
